_comment: Pterodactyl egg for Golden IQ MUSIC Bot. Import via the admin panel: Nests -> (choose a nest) -> Import Egg.
name: Golden IQ MUSIC Bot
author: info@goldeniq.email
description: Discord music bot from Golden IQ. Supports YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Last.fm, slash commands and Lavalink v3/v4.
startup: bash -c 'cd /home/container && if [ ! -f start.sh ]; then echo "[boot] start.sh missing — attempting self-heal..."; if [ ! -d .git ] && [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then echo "[boot] No repo present; cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS} (branch=${BRANCH:-main})"; git clone --branch "${BRANCH:-main}" --single-branch "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /tmp/_repo && cp -rn /tmp/_repo/. . && rm -rf /tmp/_repo; fi; if [ -f deploy_handlers/start.sh ]; then echo "[boot] Restoring start.sh from deploy_handlers/start.sh"; cp deploy_handlers/start.sh start.sh && chmod +x start.sh; else echo "[boot] FATAL: deploy_handlers/start.sh not found. Reinstall the server from the Pterodactyl panel."; exit 127; fi; fi; exec bash start.sh'

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

apt update
apt install -y --no-install-recommends git curl ca-certificates openjdk-17-jre-headless

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Redirect pip temp/build dirs onto the server volume so /tmp (which is
# small / RAM-backed in many Pterodactyl setups) does not run out of space
# while building wheels for heavy deps.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.tmp /mnt/server/.pip-cache
export TMPDIR=/mnt/server/.tmp
export PIP_CACHE_DIR=/mnt/server/.pip-cache

if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ] && [ ! -d .git ]; then
  echo "[install] Cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS} (branch=${BRANCH:-main})"
  if [ -z "$(ls -A . 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    git clone --branch "${BRANCH:-main}" --single-branch "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
  else
    git clone --branch "${BRANCH:-main}" --single-branch "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /tmp/repo
    cp -rn /tmp/repo/. .
    rm -rf /tmp/repo
  fi
fi

# Stage start.sh as early as possible — before pip/apt have a chance to fail —
# so the runtime container always finds /home/container/start.sh. The runtime
# startup command also self-heals from deploy_handlers/start.sh if this file
# is ever deleted, but copying it up-front avoids the self-heal path entirely.
if [ -f deploy_handlers/start.sh ]; then
  cp deploy_handlers/start.sh /mnt/server/start.sh
  chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh
  echo "[install] Staged start.sh from deploy_handlers/start.sh"
else
  echo "[install] WARNING: deploy_handlers/start.sh missing in the cloned repo — runtime self-heal will fail."
fi

# Optionally trim heavy browser-automation deps from requirements.txt to
# save ~250 MB of disk during install. Default: 0 (skip them).
if [ -f requirements.txt ] && [ "${INSTALL_BROWSER_DEPS:-0}" != "1" ]; then
  echo '[install] INSTALL_BROWSER_DEPS=0 -> stripping nodriver / undetected-chromedriver from requirements.txt'
  sed -i -E '/^(nodriver|undetected-chromedriver)([[:space:]=<>!]|$)/Id' requirements.txt
fi

if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then
  python3 -m pip install --upgrade --no-cache-dir pip wheel setuptools
  python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
fi

# Free build artefacts that we no longer need on the bot's volume.
rm -rf /mnt/server/.tmp /mnt/server/.pip-cache

# Force env-var-driven config on Pterodactyl: remove any stale .env that
# could shadow the variables set in the panel (dotenv_values() in
# config_loader.py overrides os.environ if a .env file exists).
rm -f .env config.json

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/start.sh ]; then
  echo "[install] ERROR: /mnt/server/start.sh was not staged. The runtime container will fail to boot. Check that deploy_handlers/start.sh exists in the cloned repo."
  exit 1
fi

echo "[install] Done."

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: The bot token from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: Git URL to clone the bot from on first install. Defaults to the official Golden IQ MUSIC Bot repo so a new server installs with zero manual uploads. Override only if you maintain a private fork (use https://<user>:<token>@github.com/... for private repos).

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone when GIT_ADDRESS is set.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Set to 1 to force-sync the bot to origin/<BRANCH> on every start (git fetch + reset --hard). Default 1 so new servers always boot with the latest code from GitHub.

variables.name: Skip pip install on start
variables.description: Set to 1 to skip pip install on every start (faster boot).

variables.name: Install Browser Deps
variables.description: Set to 1 to install nodriver + undetected-chromedriver (only needed for YouTube po_token refresh). Adds ~250 MB of disk. Default 0 to keep installs small on Pterodactyl.

variables.name: MongoDB URL
variables.description: Optional. MongoDB connection string.

variables.name: Default Prefix
variables.description: Prefix for legacy text commands.

variables.name: Owner IDs
variables.description: Space-separated Discord user IDs with owner privileges.

variables.name: Run Local Lavalink
variables.description: If true, the bot downloads and runs Lavalink.jar inside the container.

variables.name: Connect Local Lavalink
variables.description: If true, bot connects to the local Lavalink instance.

variables.name: Auto Download Lavalink Serverlist
variables.description: Fetch a public Lavalink server list when local is disabled.

variables.name: Lavalink Initial RAM (MB)
variables.description: JVM -Xms value for local Lavalink.

variables.name: Lavalink RAM Limit (MB)
variables.description: JVM -Xmx value for local Lavalink.

variables.name: Last.fm Key
variables.description: Optional. Last.fm API key.

variables.name: Last.fm Secret
variables.description: Optional. Last.fm API secret.

variables.name: Spotify Client ID
variables.description: Optional. Spotify API client ID.

variables.name: Spotify Client Secret
variables.description: Optional. Spotify API client secret.

variables.name: Error Report Webhook
variables.description: Optional. Discord webhook URL for manual error reports.

variables.name: Auto Error Report Webhook
variables.description: Optional. Discord webhook URL for automatic error reports.

variables.name: RPC Port
variables.description: Port for the RPC web server.

variables.name: Default player skin
variables.description: រូបរាង player លំនាំដើម / Default player skin. One of: classic, default, default_progressbar, embed_link, lite, micro_controller, micro_nc, mini, minimalist, miniplayer.

variables.name: Default static player skin
variables.description: រូបរាង player ថេរ (song-request channel) / Default skin for the fixed song-request player. One of: classic, default, default_progressbar, embed_link, mini.

variables.name: Support server invite
variables.description: តំណ server ជំនួយ / Support server invite URL. Shown as a button on error messages so users can report the Error ID.

variables.name: Remote Lavalink server list
variables.description: បញ្ជី Lavalink ពីចម្ងាយ / URL to a remote Lavalink server list. Leave blank to use the bundled local Lavalink.

variables.name: Idle timeout (seconds)
variables.description: រយៈពេលរង់ចាំមុនចាកចេញ / Seconds the player stays connected with nothing playing before it disconnects.

variables.name: Embed color
variables.description: ពណ៌ embed / Embed accent color as a hex value such as D4AF37. Leave blank to follow the bot's role color.
